records.title: Single-interface fixed-drive formation and recovery
records.scope: Axisymmetric, isothermal single-interface model with bulk absorption and leading viscous wall loss; numerical evidence only.
records.verdict: Finite-horizon formation and recovery demonstrated in the declared single-interface model.

records.title: Independent two-face target under fixed-command refinement
records.scope: Hypothetical three-fluid cylinder and independently chosen Cartesian patches; the pair is not a shared-conjugate stigmatic singlet.
records.verdict: Fixed-command refinement fails the height criterion; this prescription is historical evidence.

records.title: Shared-conjugate pair under prescribed mean load
records.scope: Numerical three-fluid axisymmetric Stokes trajectory with prescribed spatial traction and hypothetical viscosities; no acoustic source synthesis.
records.verdict: The declared mechanical trajectory reaches the numerical optical target; acoustic reachability remains open.

records.title: NOA 61 / water emitter-driven design-grid equilibrium
records.scope: Idealized lossless longitudinal acoustics with passive Robin port loss; hypothetical source boundaries, no thermal or wall-layer mean streaming model.
records.verdict: Coupled design-grid root converged but height and ray-coverage gates fail; fixed-command refinement is unfinished.

records.title: Partial emitter-driven Stokes startup diagnostic
records.scope: Partial unrefined creeping-flow numerical trajectory; the conservative Reynolds estimate motivates a review stop.
records.verdict: Saved trajectory does not form the target; no settling-time or impossibility inference follows.

records.title: Physical checks of a converged two-interface emitter surrogate
records.scope: Axisymmetric, lossless acoustics with ideal velocity sources, creeping flow; numerical evidence only.
records.verdict: Linearly stable but neither robust nor reachable: the design-grid success does not survive the surface space, the back face is not wave-resolved to 10 nm, and the target is not the state reached from flat.

records.title: Faithful modal synthesis from the acoustics-off meniscus
records.scope: Axisymmetric, lossless acoustics with ideal velocity sources, creeping flow; numerical evidence only.
records.verdict: Formed from the acoustics-off meniscus, converged and stable within 1 W / 2 MPa, but the optical gates fail (19.6 / 11.3 nm against 10 nm; spot 7.2 um).

records.title: Published Fig. 9b singlet in a tuned-liquid cell
records.scope: Axisymmetric, lossless acoustics with ideal velocity sources, creeping flow; numerical evidence only. The liquid set is an assumption.
records.verdict: Formed from the meniscus, converged and stable, near diffraction-limited; the front face misses 10 nm (27 nm). Its claim that water cannot reach Fig. 9b is withdrawn by S09.

records.title: Fig. 9b on the common machine (one of three fully checked designs)
records.scope: Axisymmetric, lossless acoustics with ideal velocity sources, creeping flow; numerical evidence only.
records.verdict: One fixed water / NOA 61 / water machine holds all 68 fitting family singlets (convex bound below 0.5 nm); 67 form from rest within 1 nm with one or two tones. Fig. 9b, Fig. 7a (fold margin) and lens 7 pass refinement, coupled stability and formation within 1 nm; lens 57 is a start-up path failure.
